schema_version.description: Request contract version; must be 1 when present.

repository.description: Absolute path of the Git repository to query. Defaults to the caller's workspace root; never inferred from the tool cwd.

selector.description: Selector of the node to query, as search and other results print it: symbol:<path>#<qualified>:<kind>, file:<path>, or dir:<path>.

confidence.description: Minimum resolution confidence: exact, import_resolved, same_module, or fuzzy_name (name-only matches, which include cross-crate callers through re-exports). Default same_module; when nothing meets it, fuzzy_name matches are returned under fallback.

kind.description: Restrict to one reference or relation kind.

limit.description: Cap on each result array, nested ones included (refs, relations and the lists inside their entries); 1-500, default 50. Cut arrays are reported in truncation.
